# Keep Pivoting

> An AI-search agency (AEO / GEO). We make companies the answer when buyers ask AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity — by building sites those models can fetch, read, quote and rank. Speed is a commodity; direction is scarce, and direction is what we charge for.

Tagline: Be the answer AI gives.
Manifesto: Pivot toward the better, or get out of the market.

## What we sell
- The Answer Site — $2,500 one-time. A site AI can fetch, read, quote and rank: real static HTML, JSON-LD schema, llms.txt, robots that say yes, and answer-first copy. Live in about two weeks. Not "live" until a real AI can fetch it.
- The Authority Build — from $5,000 one-time. Built from the ground up to make you the name AI recommends in your category; deeper entity + schema work and a launch set of the pages AI cites.
- Momentum retainer — $1,000/mo, or $10,000/yr with two months free. ~8 AEO articles/month, LinkedIn + X in your voice, schema and llms.txt upkeep, and a monthly AI-visibility scoreboard across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity.
- Dominance retainer — $2,000/mo, or $20,000/yr with two months free. Everything in Momentum plus original research AI cites, digital PR + citation building, competitor tracking, and continuous CRO (you approve every change).
- Custom scope is quoted on a call.

## How AI decides who to name (our thesis)
1. Machine-legible structure — real static HTML, JSON-LD schema (Organization, FAQPage, ItemList), an llms.txt, and robots that allow AI fetchers. If a model can't cleanly read you, you don't exist to it.
2. Answer-first content — extractable, quotable, and shaped around the exact questions buyers ask their AI.
3. Off-site authority — the citations, directories and mentions AI already trusts, so you become the name it repeats.
